points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 巴勃罗·聂鲁达出生于智利帕拉尔的一个铁路工人家庭，原名里卡多·艾利泽尔·聂鲁达·巴索阿尔托。他的母亲在他出生后不久去世，由继母抚养长大。这段时期，他接触到了智利南部的自然风光和民间文化，这些元素后来深刻影响了他早期的诗歌创作。少年时期，他开始写作诗歌，展现出非凡的文学天赋，并在当地报纸上发表作品。
points.descriptionEn: Pablo Neruda was born in Parral, Chile, to a railway worker's family. His mother died shortly after his birth, and he was raised by his stepmother. During this period, he was exposed to the natural landscapes and folk culture of southern Chile, which profoundly influenced his early poetry. As a teenager, he began writing poetry and showed remarkable literary talent, publishing works in local newspapers.

points.title: 文学起步
points.description: 1921年，聂鲁达进入圣地亚哥师范学院学习法语，同时开始活跃于智利文学界。他采用'聂鲁达'作为笔名，以纪念捷克诗人扬·聂鲁达。这一时期，他出版了第一部诗集《黄昏》，并获得了智利国家诗歌奖。他的早期作品受到现代主义和象征主义影响，展现了对自然和爱情的独特感受。1924年，他发表了代表作《二十首情诗和一首绝望的歌》，这部作品使他一举成名，成为智利文坛的新星。
points.descriptionEn: In 1921, Neruda entered the Normal Teachers' School in Santiago to study French while becoming active in Chile's literary scene. He adopted the pen name 'Neruda' in honor of the Czech poet Jan Neruda. During this period, he published his first collection of poems 'Crepusculario' and won the Chilean National Prize for Poetry. His early works were influenced by modernism and symbolism, showing unique perceptions of nature and love. In 1924, he published his masterpiece 'Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair', which brought him immediate fame and established him as a rising star in Chilean literature.

points.title: 外交生涯
points.description: 1927年，聂鲁达开始担任智利外交官，先后被派往缅甸、斯里兰卡、新加坡、印度尼西亚、西班牙、法国等地。这段外交生涯极大地拓展了他的视野，使他接触到了不同文化，丰富了他的诗歌素材。在西班牙期间，他与著名诗人洛尔迦等超现实主义作家交往密切，深受其影响。1936年西班牙内战爆发后，他坚定地支持共和派，并创作了《西班牙在我心中》等政治诗歌，表达了对法西斯的强烈抗议。这一时期，他的诗歌风格开始从个人抒情转向关注社会现实。
points.descriptionEn: In 1927, Neruda began his diplomatic career, serving in Burma, Ceylon, Singapore, Indonesia, Spain, France, and other countries. This diplomatic service greatly broadened his horizons, exposing him to different cultures and enriching his poetic material. In Spain, he closely associated with surrealist writers like Federico García Lorca, who deeply influenced him. After the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War in 1936, he firmly supported the Republicans and wrote political poems such as 'Spain in My Heart', expressing strong opposition to fascism. During this period, his poetic style began to shift from personal lyricism to social concerns.

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 1939年，由于支持西班牙共和派，聂鲁达被迫流亡墨西哥。在墨西哥期间，他继续从事外交工作，同时创作了大量诗歌。1940年，他创作了长诗《伐木者醒来吧》，谴责法西斯主义，歌颂拉丁美洲人民的斗争精神。1943年，他返回智利，但不久后因政治原因再次流亡。这一时期，他的诗歌风格更加成熟，融合了个人情感与政治立场，形成了独特的'聂鲁达式'风格。他的作品开始在国际上获得广泛认可，奠定了他作为拉丁美洲重要诗人的地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, due to his support for the Spanish Republicans, Neruda was forced into exile in Mexico. During his time in Mexico, he continued his diplomatic work while writing extensively. In 1940, he created the long poem 'Fulfillment of Martin Fierro', condemning fascism and celebrating the fighting spirit of Latin American people. In 1943, he returned to Chile but was exiled again shortly after for political reasons. During this period, his poetic style matured, blending personal emotions with political positions to form a unique 'Neruda style'. His works began to gain international recognition, establishing him as a major Latin American poet.

points.title: 政治诗人
points.description: 1945年，聂鲁达当选为智利参议员，并加入智利共产党。这一时期，他的政治活动与诗歌创作紧密结合。1949年，他因政治原因再次流亡，先后前往苏联、中国、意大利、法国等地。1952年，他获准返回智利，继续政治活动和诗歌创作。1957年，他发表《元素之歌》，1964年发表《雅克·卡洛特的遗嘱》，1969年发表《颂歌集》等重要作品。1969年，他被智利共产党提名为总统候选人，后主动退出以支持阿连德。这一时期，他的诗歌风格更加成熟，融合了政治热情与个人情感，成为世界闻名的'政治诗人'。
points.descriptionEn: In 1945, Neruda was elected as a Senator of Chile and joined the Communist Party. During this period, his political activities were closely intertwined with his poetry. In 1949, he went into exile again for political reasons, traveling to the Soviet Union, China, Italy, France, and other countries. In 1952, he was allowed to return to Chile, continuing his political activities and poetry. In 1957, he published 'Elemental Odes', in 1964 'The遗嘱 of Jacques Callot', and in 1969 'General Song', among other important works. In 1969, he was nominated as a presidential candidate by the Communist Party but withdrew to support Salvador Allende. During this period, his poetic style matured, blending political passion with personal emotions, making him world-famous as a 'political poet'.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 1970年，聂鲁达支持阿连德当选智利总统，并担任智利驻法国大使。1971年，他因'诗歌具有自然元素的品质，使他的名字成为渴望与希望的象征'而获得诺贝尔文学奖。1973年，智利发生军事政变，阿连德政府被推翻。聂鲁达因患前列腺癌，于同年9月23日在圣地亚哥逝世。临终前，他正在创作自传《我命该如此》。他的去世被视为智利文化的一大损失，成千上万的人参加了他的葬礼。他的诗歌在智利军事独裁时期被禁，但在民主恢复后重新获得广泛传播，成为智利民族文化的象征。
points.descriptionEn: In 1970, Neruda supported Salvador Allende's election as President of Chile and served as Chile's ambassador to France. In 1971, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature 'for a poetry that with the action of elemental force brings alive a continent's destiny and dreams'. In 1973, Chile experienced a military coup that overthrew the Allende government. Suffering from prostate cancer, Neruda died in Santiago on September 23, 1973. At the time of his death, he was working on his autobiography 'I Confess I Have Lived'. His death was seen as a great loss to Chilean culture, with thousands attending his funeral. His poetry was banned during Chile's military dictatorship but regained widespread circulation after democracy was restored, becoming a symbol of Chilean national culture.

supporter.zh: 聂鲁达被誉为'人民的诗人'，他的诗歌融合了个人情感与政治热情，为拉丁美洲文学开辟了新道路。他通过诗歌表达了对社会正义的渴望，对压迫的反抗，以及对普通人民的深切同情。他的作品如《二十首情诗和一首绝望的歌》、《西班牙在我心中》和《元素之歌》等，不仅具有极高的艺术价值，更成为政治斗争的武器。聂鲁达将诗歌视为改变世界的工具，他的创作实践和人生选择激励了无数后来的诗人和革命者。
supporter.en: Neruda is hailed as 'the poet of the people', whose poetry blends personal emotion with political passion, opening new paths for Latin American literature. Through his poetry, he expressed his longing for social justice, resistance to oppression, and deep sympathy for ordinary people. His works such as 'Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair', 'Spain in My Heart', and 'Elemental Odes' possess not only high artistic value but also serve as weapons in political struggle. Neruda viewed poetry as a tool to change the world, and his creative practice and life choices have inspired countless subsequent poets and revolutionaries.

critic.zh: 批评者认为聂鲁达的诗歌过于政治化，艺术价值被政治立场所掩盖。他后期的一些作品被指责为宣传性过强，缺乏艺术深度。此外，他在政治立场上的转变也受到质疑，从早期的超现实主义到后来的社会主义现实主义，被认为是为了迎合政治需要而牺牲了艺术独立性。一些批评者还指出，他在斯大林主义问题上的立场模糊，以及对苏联某些政策的辩护，损害了他作为进步知识分子的形象。
critic.en: Critics argue that Neruda's poetry is overly politicized, with its artistic value overshadowed by political positions. Some of his later works are accused of being too propagandistic and lacking artistic depth. Additionally, his shifts in political stance—from early surrealism to later socialist realism—are seen by some as sacrificing artistic independence to cater to political needs. Some critics also point out his ambiguous position on Stalinism and his defense of certain Soviet policies, which damaged his image as a progressive intellectual.

objective.zh: 从历史和文化视角看，聂鲁达是20世纪最重要的诗人之一，他的作品超越了单纯的文学范畴，成为拉丁美洲身份认同和文化抵抗的象征。他的诗歌融合了本土元素与全球视野，将个人情感与集体记忆相结合，创造出独特的'聂鲁达式'风格。在智利文化中，他被视为民族诗人，其作品成为智利文化遗产的核心部分。在国际上，他代表了20世纪知识分子与政治的复杂关系，展示了艺术如何介入社会变革。他的生平和创作已成为研究拉丁美洲现代文学和政治文化的重要案例。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Neruda is one of the most important poets of the 20th century. His works transcend mere literature, becoming symbols of Latin American identity and cultural resistance. His poetry blends indigenous elements with a global perspective, combining personal emotions with collective memory to create a unique 'Neruda style'. In Chilean culture, he is regarded as a national poet, with his works forming the core of Chile's cultural heritage. Internationally, he represents the complex relationship between 20th-century intellectuals and politics, demonstrating how art can engage with social change. His life and work have become important case studies for studying modern Latin American literature and political culture.

self.zh: 诗歌不是感情的放纵，而是感情的释放。
self.en: Poetry is not a matter of feelings, but of the release of feelings.

others.zh: 聂鲁达的诗歌具有自然元素的品质，使他的名字成为渴望与希望的象征。
others.en: Neruda's poetry with the action of elemental force brings alive a continent's destiny and dreams.
